characters.description: The Limitless Lands AI oversees Raytak's MedPod treatment, supporting his cognition while shielding him from memories that could endanger his recovery.
characters.name: Cleo

characters.description: Raytak's son and a director of the MedPod company. He supervises his father's treatment while keeping their family connection from Raytak inside the game.
characters.name: Trey

characters.description: A fellow MedPod patient and Raytak's trusted scout leader in Limitless Lands. He can work beside Raytak in the game without placing Raytak's protected memories at risk.
characters.name: Tai

characters.description: The mayor responsible for developing Hayden's Knoll. He supports the settlement's growth and works with Raytak to strengthen its position in Limitless Lands.
characters.name: Delling

characters.description: An experienced Imperium noncommissioned officer who serves as Raytak's field adviser and helps direct garrison operations and troop assignments.
characters.name: Brooks

characters.description: Yendis's unicorn-beetle animal companion, accompanying her during field expeditions and dangerous investigations.
characters.name: Crunchy

characters.description: Leader of a clan allied with Hayden's Knoll. Raytak can call on the clan under an established pact when the settlement faces a major threat.
characters.name: the Forerunner clan leader

characters.description: A rival player ruler and one of Delling's scholarship competitors. After an unsuccessful attack on Haven, he retains executioners, a necromancer ally, and a funded scheme against Raytak.
characters.name: Brandon

characters.description: Brandon's surviving ally, an undead specialist who accepts paid work and reports that the operation against Raytak is already under way.
characters.name: the necromancer

characters.description: An ancient parasite able to invade and consume a host's mind. Freed from a sealed mountain ruin, it takes control of a gnoll leader while hiding the change from the surrounding tribe.
characters.name: the parasite master

characters.description: An Imperium commander and MedPod patient who is convicted with planted evidence and stripped of his Legion. Reduced to a level-zero Disgraced Commander, he accepts imprisonment to pursue exoneration through the Retribution path.
characters.name: Raytak

characters.description: The replacement officer whose platoon assumes responsibility for Hayden's Knoll after Raytak's Legion is dissolved.
characters.name: Lieutenant Burnside

characters.description: A corrupt Imperium official who uses planted documents and summary powers to convict Raytak, dissolve his Legion, and install a replacement garrison.
characters.name: the field inspector

characters.description: A disgraced Imperium soldier imprisoned with Raytak. His hatred of officers makes him Raytak's most immediate threat among the transported prisoners.
characters.name: the former sergeant

characters.description: A promoter who buys prisoner contracts and coerces the captives into gladiatorial combat, treating Raytak and the other soldiers as expendable arena assets.
characters.name: the gladiatorial-school owner

characters.description: An arena official who validates the prisoners' supposed consent to fight and supports the coercive arrangement imposed by their contract holder.
characters.name: Asif

characters.description: A druid who joins the time-sensitive effort to uncover who engineered Raytak's false conviction. She brings field skills, an animal companion, and a commitment to freeing him.
characters.name: Yendis

characters.description: A member of the party investigating Raytak's conviction. He joins the search for evidence behind the false treason charge.
characters.name: Jacoby

characters.description: A Hayden's Knoll merchant and informant who directs Yendis toward a suspected lead connected with the people behind Raytak's conviction.
characters.name: Phineas

characters.description: A goblin apprenticed to Phineas by Chief Bugtug. His dishonest sales earn him the Shady Merchant class.
characters.name: Eyeball

characters.description: Raytak's granddaughter and the real-world player behind Yendis. She visits him in his MedPod and recruits additional help for the effort to free him in Limitless Lands.
characters.name: Lauren

characters.description: Lauren's ally and a level-eight barbarian player recruited for the mission to help Raytak. Limitless Lands has given him opportunities for friendship and social engagement.
characters.name: Nolan

characters.description: A slaver leader transporting captured gnolls. Parasites infiltrate his caravan and absorb the slavers into their growing hive.
characters.name: Saunders

characters.description: A slaver who leads a raid on a nearby farm before becoming infected by the parasite hive.
characters.name: Jameson

characters.description: A project coordinator and addiction researcher who asks Trey to examine whether MedPod treatment and a supportive virtual environment could assist patients through withdrawal.
characters.name: Dr. Nassif

characters.description: A company representative who leads a public marketing announcement for merchandise based on Limitless Lands characters and scenes.
characters.name: Gloria

characters.description: A regional dwarf investigator whose people may provide an official inquiry into Raytak's conviction. He supports the search for evidence and understands the dangers around the dwarven routes.
characters.name: the dwarf pathfinder leader

characters.description: A ward-bound legendary creature encountered by Yendis’s party in a darkened sealed chamber. It detects lies and makes consequential riddles the price of escape.
characters.name: the sphinx

characters.description: A veteran merchant who agrees to outfit Raytak's growing prisoner force after deciding that Raytak genuinely values the soldiers under his command.
characters.name: the retired Imperium soldier

characters.description: A soldier in Raytak's prisoner unit who detects three spies watching the camp.
characters.name: the infiltrator

characters.description: The infiltrator who exposed the spies around Raytak's camp. A divine boon makes his improvised butter knives unusually effective weapons.
characters.name: Butterknife Buford

characters.description: A prison guard who comes to believe Raytak is honorable. He quietly provides intelligence about the capital tournament and conceals magical fire javelins for Raytak's force.
characters.name: the former prison guard

characters.description: A favored Grand Melee contender whose exceptional size and strength make him one of the tournament's most dangerous threats.
characters.name: the stone giant

characters.description: A defensive-garrison officer who helps Raytak resume command at Hayden's Knoll.
characters.name: Lieutenant Gamble

characters.description: Tai's wife, waiting with their extended family when he emerges from MedPod treatment. She welcomes him back as he begins the physical work of recovery.
characters.name: Judith

characters.description: Trey's mother and Raytak's wife. Medically stabilized in a MedPod, she lives in a private lakeside virtual environment where family members can visit her.
characters.name: Natalie

characters.description: Commander of the depleted dwarf force allied with Raytak against the Holdfast infestation. He brings survivors and knowledge of the parasite threat to the joint campaign.
characters.name: the dwarf war leader

characters.description: An intelligent parasite that rejects the Holdfast master's rule. It secretly leaves with several dozen drones to establish an independent hive beyond the master's control.
characters.name: the parasite daughter

characters.description: An unnamed infernal patron who enforces a soul contract, destroys the necromancer and undead minions, and compels Brandon into unknown service through a portal.
characters.name: the imp patron
